images.title: Two kinds of matchstick
images.purpose: Show that the horizontal and diagonal sticks can be counted separately in one step.
images.composition: A single strip of 2 triangles in the centre with two labels and the rule beneath; white space around.
exact_structure: One strip of exactly 2 triangles side by side (Step 2), one pointing up on the left and one pointing down on the right, made of 5 matchsticks.
The 2 horizontal sticks (one along the bottom of the left triangle, one along the top of the right triangle) are teal #0072B2.
The 3 slanting sticks (the left side, the middle shared one and the right side) are amber #E69F00.
A teal #0072B2 label "2 horizontal" with a thin grey #6B7280 line to the horizontal sticks, and an amber #E69F00 label "3 diagonal" with a thin grey line to the slanting sticks.
Above the strip the text "Step 2"; below it the line "Step y: y and y + 1" with the y in reddish purple #CC79A7.
rejection: a strip with other than 2 triangles or 5 sticks
horizontal and diagonal counts other than 2 and 3
images.takeaway: Horizontal sticks number y and diagonal sticks number y + 1, and together they are 2y + 1.
images.description: A two triangle matchstick strip with 2 teal horizontal sticks and 3 amber diagonal sticks labelled, and the rule y and y + 1.
images.context: Shown beside the orientation counting text.
images.teaching_notes: Count the teal sticks and the amber sticks separately, then see how each count relates to the step number.

image_decisions.why: Splitting by orientation gives a second way to reach the same formula.
